jobs.description:
Do you have experience in logistics and a natural talent for leadership?

For a modern logistics company, we are looking for a Team Leader who can lead, motivate, and support the warehouse team while contributing daily to the smooth operation of all logistics activities.

Your Role: The Driving Force Behind the Team

As a Team Leader, you are the first point of contact for a team of warehouse operators. You ensure that all processes, from receiving goods to shipping orders, are carried out safely, efficiently, and accurately. You motivate your team, provide guidance when needed, and maintain a clear overview of daily operations.
Your Responsibilities:

 
• Leading, coaching, and supporting the logistics team on the warehouse floor
 
• Coordinating daily warehouse activities and resolving operational challenges
 
• Monitoring planning, safety, and quality standards
 
• Collaborating with other departments and proactively contributing solutions
 
• Rolling up your sleeves and assisting with operational tasks when required

 
• You have leadership experience and know how to motivate people in a positive and constructive way.
 
• You have strong communication skills and are flexible.
 
• You are fluent in English.
 
• You have experience leading a team and hold a valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate.
 
• You enjoy working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system or on a fixed night shift.

Step into a rewarding logistics role as an electric pallet truck (EPT) order picker at Logent in Evergem in a 2-shift system with competitive pay and strong benefits!

Looking for a role where your precision and energy keep logistics moving forward? As an electric pallet truck (EPT) order picker at Logent, you are at the heart of our facility. You take pride in driving efficiency, organizing stock seamlessly, and ensuring every order moves through the facility with accuracy and care.

 Apply today via 09 218 79 35 or talentcenter40@randstad.be to join the team of Logent. 

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for? 

• Proven experience in operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT).
• In possession of a valid EPT certificate or license.
• Available and flexible to work in a rotating two-shift schedule (early and late shifts).
• Good communication skills in English to ensure clear team collaboration.
• You have your own means of transport to reach the site in Evergem. 
As an EPT order picker, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and safe movement of goods throughout the facility.

• Navigate the facility safely using an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) to collect and transport orders.
• Handle materials with precision during loading and unloading processes to keep stock damage-free.
• Organise and stack incoming items following exact warehouse procedures and safety guidelines.
• Assist with accurate stock tracking, inventory counts, and shelf replenishment.

•

•

For a client who represents the lifts, escalators and moving walks associations is looking for a management assistant. If you recognize yourself in this offer, apply with your resume.

Jobomschrijving

Description

• The assistant will be the first point of contact for callers and visitors and will be responsible for the meeting rooms - taking telephone calls, welcoming visitors, and booking meeting venues.
• The successful candidate will also provide general support to the day-to-day running of the office in Brussels and the organization of various meetings and events. 
• He/she will report to the Senior Officer and to the Secretary General of the Association.
• Essential Duties & Responsibilities
• Handle incoming calls and coordinate messages as needed.
• Provide assistance and support to the Senior Officer and Secretary General.
• Day-to-day office management: liaise with suppliers, organize incoming mail and postal services, and maintain office/food supplies and other requirements to keep the office running smoothly including office equipment and office space.
• Administrative and financial work: filing invoices, prepare payments.
• Provide administrative support in booking travel, filing, and updating contacts.
• Provide logistical and administrative support in the organization of internal and external meetings and events.
• Provide ad hoc logistical support to international colleagues for organizing meetings in Brussels.
• Update and manage the website.
• Manage orders of office supplies, courier services, catering, cleaning staff etc. 
• Liaise with IT service providers, designers, printers, translators, etc. 
• Manage membership fees for members.
• Assist in preparing the annual General Assembly.
• Perform other related duties as required.
• Taking minutes during the Committees and Working Groups meetingsEducation / Experience
• At least three years of relevant experience in administrative support.
• Secretarial studies is an asset.

Skills Required

• Fluency in French and English - other languages is an asset.
• Excellent communication and organizational skills.
• Excellent computer skills (MS Office, experience with databases, etc.).
• Comfortable in multi-tasking, detail-oriented, and working to deadlines.
• Flexible and adaptable approach to work.
• Basic accounting knowledge. Compensation

About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:

• Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.
• Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.
• Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.
• Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.
• Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.
• Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Big Water Consulting - Senior .NET Architect Service
jobs.description:
Client is looking for a Senior .NET Architect to lead technically a portfolio in different

domain areas. The role of the architect is to support and lead the technical aspect of the

portfolio he/she will work for.

The applications are complex ones and are using Blazor as frontend technology. As the

developers are really experienced, the challenge for the architects is to support them

regarding issues they will have more architecture designs.One goal is to integrate an existing

team to maintain and support it. One of the mission will be to modernize the application and

migrate the services to .NET 10 and adopt modern architecture

The tech lead will manage Full Stack .NET developers working on micro-services products.

The technologies used are:

• C#.NET 10 and .NET 4.x

• SQL/MongoDB

• Blazor

• Hangfire

• RabbitMQ

• Clean architecture.

• NServiceBus => Dapr

Additional information

Location: 2days/week onsite , 3days/week remote

• Languages: English is a must with very good knowledge of Dutch or French

• Min 4 years of experiences as .NET Architect

• Onsite presence for 2 days per week is required

• Good communication skill

• Coaching developer teams

• Be a player role in a Scrum teams

• Take the lead of multiple dev teams (help coordinate the work during a sprint) 

• Seniority on technical issue investigation (good analytics skills)

• Give a good vision on the target architecture

• Challenge technical choice with other Tech leads and Dev

• Challenge feature with PO

• Explain to non-business people the technical aspect

• Organize collaborative technical session with developers and architects

• Handle priority and emergency in efficient way

• Structured in the solution approach

• Explore new technologies and keep a good technical watch

To realize future growth, we are looking into extending our team with a Supply Chain Officer to support the service functions

Client Details

The company is active in the industrial sector

Description

What does your job responsibilities include?

• Manage suppliers : orders, payments, price negotiation
• Manage stock, replenishments
• Manage declarations and ensure compliance with regulations related to our activities
• Manage ERP (Odoo)
• Order entry and follow up of orders with all related documents (shipping, customs, export…)
• Provide sales related support for other departments within the company (internal) and for Memolub's extensive distributor network (external).
 

Required Qualifications:

• Fluent in French or Dutch. Good level of English. Other language appreciated
• Previous experience in a similar role in export, preferably in the industry.
• Be interested in technology
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team.
• Proficiency in IT tools. (Internal IT tools)
• Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines..

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!
 

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!
 

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
 

 
• Manually picking orders
 
• Packing and labelling products
 
• Processing shipping documents
 
• Working with handheld scanners 
 

You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
 

 
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
 
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
 
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
 
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
 
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
 
• You speak English fluently
